quarantined_leads.lead: Bangor Daily News, with AP follow-up, reported that Republican Maine gubernatorial nominee Bobby Charles told Maine Young Republicans on August 20 that he would ask the administration to send ICE agents and U.S. Marshals to Maine polling places before the 2026 election. The reporting says federal law may prohibit armed federal agents at polling places, but no official complaint, investigation, charge, or final finding was located in this window.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Bobby Charles said he’ll ask Donald Trump’s border czar to send ICE and marshals to Maine polls
quarantined_leads.subject_response: No direct response to the reported polling-place proposal was located. The article separately reports that Charles sought some distance from President Trump in remarks at another campaign stop.
quarantined_leads.reason: Charles’s Republican affiliation is explicit, but the report concerns a proposed future action rather than a completed misconduct event or an official proceeding. The BDN and AP reports do not establish a charge, finding, or adjudicated violation, so the lead is retained for follow-up and not auto-published.
